findings.summary: The 1x1-kernel shortcut in get_delta_weight checks only two spatial dims (weight.size()[2:4] == (1,1)), so Conv3d kernels (1,1,1) or (1,1,k) wrongly take the shortcut, causing shape errors or wrong deltas on merge(); it should check all spatial dims.
The Conv3d kernel-dimension error message wrongly says 'Conv2d layer kernel must have 5 dimensions' instead of Conv3d.

conv_fn is set in the subclass __init__ after super().__init__() has run update_layer, so any init path calling get_delta_weight (e.g. loftq, pissa, olora) would raise AttributeError; making it a class attribute would remove the risk.
